subject.title: Provider Exclusion List Project (Improvements) & MMIS AI Project (Kickoff)
details: Provider Exclusion List Project (Improvements): Split single search field into six separate fields: First Name, Last Name, Business Name, NPI, State, City. Added NPI as a dedicated search field. Implemented staging tables (staging_federal, staging_state) for multi-source data import. Added source and source_id fields to track data origin. Fixed UUID issue by changing primary key to integer. Updated dbdiagram.io ERD with NOT NULL constraints. Pushed all updates to GitHub.
MMIS AI Project (Kickoff): Kicked off MMIS AI Project.

notes: Splitting the search form improves usability and allows more precise queries.
Staging tables allow importing exclusion data from multiple sources (federal and state).
Using integer primary keys avoids UUID compatibility issues with SQLite.
